name: modal
title: Modal
description: Modal dialog built on the native dialog element, with focus trapping and a close button.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog title, also used for aria-labelledby.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the modal when clicked.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action area. Wrapped in form method=dialog, so a type=submit button closes the modal.

props.name: id
props.description: Dialog id. Use it to open the modal from elsewhere with showModal().

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button.

a11y: Uses dialog with showModal(), so focus stays inside and the page behind is inert.
Escape closes the modal and returns focus to the trigger.
Clicking outside the panel (the backdrop) closes the modal.
The close button is labelled by closeLabel.

ai.whenToUse: Confirming an important action or a short form that needs full attention.
rules: Footer buttons that should close the modal must be type=submit
Never nest a modal inside another modal
Use Drawer for side panels, not Modal

id.description: Dialog modal berbasis elemen dialog native dengan fokus terkunci dan tombol tutup.

props.title: Judul dialog, dipakai juga sebagai aria-labelledby.
props.trigger: Elemen yang membuka modal saat diklik.
props.footer: Area aksi. Dibungkus form method=dialog, jadi tombol type=submit menutup modal.
props.id: Id dialog. Bisa dipakai untuk membuka modal dari luar lewat showModal().
props.closeLabel: Label aksesibel tombol tutup. Isi "Tutup" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.

a11y: Memakai dialog dan showModal(), jadi fokus terkunci di dalam modal dan konten di belakangnya inert.
Escape menutup modal dan fokus kembali ke elemen pemicu.
Klik di luar panel (backdrop) menutup modal.
Tombol tutup punya aria-label dari closeLabel (default Close).

ai.whenToUse: Konfirmasi aksi penting atau form singkat yang butuh perhatian penuh user.
rules: Tombol di footer yang harus menutup modal wajib type=submit
Jangan menumpuk modal di dalam modal
Untuk panel samping gunakan Drawer, bukan Modal
